tagline: Leading manufacturer and distributor of premium replacement parts in the automotive aftermarket
hero_kpi_rationale: The Nissens Automotive segment is a key growth driver for the company, with an increase of $305.4 million in 2025 compared to $35.7 million in 2024, reflecting the impact of a full year post-acquisition versus two months in 2024.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company
kpis.description: The company's net sales increased by 22.4% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to the acquisition of Nissens Automotive and strong demand in the Temperature Control segment.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Company's gross margin as a percentage of net sales
kpis.description: The company's gross margin increased by 2.3 percentage points in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to the inclusion of a full year of Nissens Automotive, higher sales volumes, and operational improvements.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Company's operating margin as a percentage of net sales
kpis.description: The company's operating margin increased by 2.1 percentage points in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to the inclusion of a full year of Nissens Automotive and cost reductions related to the acquisition.

kpis.name: Nissens Automotive Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Net sales from the Nissens Automotive segment acquired in November 2024
kpis.description: Net sales from the Nissens Automotive segment increased by 751.4% in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting a full year of results in 2025 versus two months in 2024 following the November 2024 acquisition.
kpis.signal: Explosive revenue growth from Nissens Automotive in 2025

kpis.name: Vehicle Control Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Net sales from the Vehicle Control segment, core of the aftermarket business
kpis.description: Net sales from the Vehicle Control segment increased by 3.0% in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting stable demand in the automotive aftermarket, with growth in engine management and electrical safety.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth from Vehicle Control in 2025

kpis.name: Temperature Control Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Net sales from the Temperature Control segment, including air conditioning systems and thermal components
kpis.description: Net sales from the Temperature Control segment increased by 12.2% in 2025 compared to 2024, benefiting from very strong customer demand, an extended summer season, market share gains, and growth in certain product categories.
kpis.signal: Significant revenue growth from Temperature Control in 2025

kpis.name: Engineered Solutions Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Net sales from the Engineered Solutions segment, providing customized solutions to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers
kpis.description: Net sales from the Engineered Solutions segment decreased by 3.8% in 2025 compared to 2024, due to lower demand from existing customers driven by cyclical weakness in global markets, partially offset by new contract wins.
kpis.signal: Decline in Engineered Solutions revenue in 2025

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Selling, general and administrative expenses of the company
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses increased by 25.5% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to a full year of Nissens Automotive ($79.3 million) and costs associated with the distribution center transition.
kpis.signal: Increase in selling, general and administrative expenses in 2025

kpis.name: Net Earnings
kpis.description: Net earnings attributable to SMP increased by 50.3% in 2025 to $41.3 million compared to $27.5 million in 2024, reflecting sales growth and margin improvement.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in net earnings in 2025

risks.title: Dependence on a limited number of key customers
risks.score_rationale: Three customers accounted for 25.2%, 18.6% and 10.5% of consolidated sales in 2025, respectively. The loss of any of these customers or a significant reduction in their purchases could have a material adverse effect on the business, financial condition and operating results.

risks.title: Exposure to international trade tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Since February 2025, U.S. import tariffs have increased. SMP operates manufacturing facilities in Canada, Mexico and China, and relies on imports from these regions. Approximately one-quarter of U.S. sales come from products manufactured in China, exposing the company to higher tariff risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies is present in SMP's 10-K/20-F filing.
